Use case: identity-preserve.
Create a transparent animation source strip of EXACTLY THREE full-body Cecilia figures arranged horizontally, one row, very generous empty margins and gutters. Reference image 1 is her strict canonical identity, proportions, detailed anime sprite art and costume. Reference image 2 is the approved existing atlas for identity only, NOT layout. Mint green long hair, normal green eyes, cream lace head veil and cape, white sleeves, navy pleated skirt with cream lace hem, dark stockings and dark shoes; preserve exactly.
Three independently drawn frames of cheek-puff animation, left to right:
A normal neutral open-eyed standing pose, relaxed hands by sides.
B starting to puff her cheeks into rounded visibly bulging cheek shapes, tiny pout lips, hands gently together at chest.
C fully rounded visibly swollen puffy cheeks and cute annoyed green eyes, tiny closed pout mouth, both shoulders slightly raised with hands gently together at chest.
Very explicit puffy CHEEK silhouette on B and C, adorable like chibi anime; no decorative anger mark.
All three figures have exact same drawing size, identical body proportions and one common foot baseline. Each whole figure including long hair must fit fully within its column with at least 20 percent column-width of empty transparent margin left and right. Center every full figure. Safe top/bottom margin, entire hair, veil, hands, skirt and shoes visible. No parts touch image borders. Landscape 3:1 canvas.
Actual transparent background, clean silhouette edges. No text, marks, numbers, symbols, props, floating decorations, shadows, scene, borders or other characters. No whole-character squash/stretch, only independently drawn cheek shape and expression change.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Create the continuation of Cecilia's cheek-puff animation, EXACTLY THREE full-body figures in one horizontal row on a landscape 3:1 transparent canvas.
Reference image 1 is her strict canonical identity. Reference image 2 is the original approved atlas for identity only. Reference image 3 is the approved first three frames of this same animation: match its exact character drawing size, head-to-body proportions, costume details, fine linework, shading, baseline and spacing. No copying its first poses, only continue naturally.
Preserve mint long hair, green eyes, cream lace head veil/cape, white sleeves, navy pleated skirt with cream lace hem, dark stockings and dark shoes.
Three next poses left to right:
D round fully puffed cheeks, little closed pout lips, adorably stubborn eyes, hands together at chest, gentle head tilt to screen-left.
E cheeks slowly deflate back to normal, eyes closed, tiny round relaxed exhale mouth, shoulders and hands lower naturally.
F normal open green eyes and slight calm smile restored, arms resting by sides, neutral cheeks, identical to the initial resting pose from first strip.
Cheek puff must be visibly drawn in the face shape, not whole-character scaling. Body remains grounded, all complete figures same scale and foot baseline. Center each in its own one-third column with generous transparent gutters at least 20% of each column width, every part including all long hair safely away from neighboring frames and canvas borders. All hair, veil, hands, skirt, stockings and shoes visible.
Actual transparent background, no words, numbers, symbols, effects, marks, stars, props, shadows, scene, borders or other characters. Exactly three fully separated figures.
